title: hs_rover_chassis
summary: 438 g, clearance 21.3 mm, tips at 41 deg, 0 problems
claim_boundary: CAD and static calculations only. Print strength, traction, wheel slip, battery life and the camera image need a printed, driven rover.

title: hs_size_rover_drive
summary: 26 of 39 gearmotor options pass; best pololu-25d-mp-12v 47:1
claim_boundary: Linear DC-motor model between the maker's no-load and (extrapolated) stall points at nominal voltage; Pololu says units stall well before the listed point as they heat. No battery sag, wheel slip or turning losses.

title: hs_energy_budget
